task.name: Package web fast-jar as CLI-sibling payload + verify on devBuild

comment.message: PACKAGING RISK DE-RISKED (proven end-to-end). CLI's trimmed jlink (23 mods) can't run Quarkus (NoClassDefFoundError sun.misc.SignalHandler = jdk.unsupported missing). Per user 'let image grow, each module lists own deps, build unions'. Quarkus jlink is achievable but jdeps breaks on fast-jar (Quarkus #32034) — must derive from UBER-JAR + add reflective blind-spots (crypto via bytecode scan, per slim-jre technique). Derived OUR list from our uber-jar: jdeps --print-module-deps gave base [java.base,java.desktop,java.logging,java.management,java.naming,java.rmi,java.transaction.xa,jdk.compiler,jdk.unsupported]; +reflective [jdk.crypto.ec,jdk.crypto.cryptoki,jdk.zipfs,jdk.localedata] (crypto TRIGGERED by SSL/TLS bytecode refs). Built union jlink image (CLI base + web mods = 19 modules total) and BOOTED the fast-jar on it: started 2.267s, HTTP 200. Plan to wire: web/build.gradle.kts declares web's module list; image_<platform> unions with io.bitken.ss.cli; jlinkSmoke boots fast-jar on assembled image to fail-loud on future dep drift.

SETTLED packaging design (decisions this session): (1) one SHARED jlink image, no 2nd JVM — fast-jar runs on bundled bin/java. (2) Module list DERIVED (jdeps on uber-jar + reflective crypto adds), PRUNED by boot-test: web declares 9 mods [java.logging,java.management,java.naming,jdk.unsupported,jdk.crypto.ec,jdk.crypto.cryptoki,jdk.zipfs,jdk.localedata]+java.base. Dropped proven-dead: java.desktop,jdk.compiler,java.rmi,java.transaction.xa. (3) INVARIANT: cli never depends on web — cli image_<platform> stays CLI-only/web-agnostic. (4) PACKAGING owns the union: reads web's webJlinkModules + cli's module path (cli exposes it as a shared PROVIDER) and runs ONE jlink with combined --add-modules; union computed ONLY when packaging builds both; cli-alone/web-alone untouched. (5) jlinkSmoke boot-test guards drift. PROVEN: union image runs shipsmooth --version AND boots Quarkus HTTP 200. web/build.gradle.kts holds the declared list (uncommitted); cli pristine. TODO: cli module-path provider, packaging union+jlink task, PackageRuntime web/ payload, session-start dev-copy, jlinkSmoke.

deviation.message: Doing Task 9 (packaging) BEFORE Task 8 per user. Split scope: the PACKAGING half (fast-jar lands in release zip + dev cache) is done now; the 'launched via web serve' half folds into Task 8. Design: web ships as SIBLING web/ of runtime/ (release zip) and <cache>/web/ (dev). Payload sourced from a SEPARATE dir (quarkus-app), NOT nested in the jlink image (keeps image pure). Two explicit consumers: PackageRuntime copies to zip-root web/; session-start installRuntime stages to <cache>/web/. web serve runs runtime/bin/java -jar web/quarkus-run.jar (reuses bundled JVM, no 2nd JVM). Also: CLI-doesnt-embed-in-build-claude-dev; runtime lives in ~/.cache/shipsmooth/<ver>/ installed by SessionStart hook.
